why: The policy decides weekly, but the first replay (weekly-passive-first-v1-replay.json) re-decided only every 21 common sessions (155 anchors). That replay stays unchanged as the 21-session reference. This protocol adds ONE weekly replay of the SAME rule.
preOutcomeDisclosure: Written and pushed before the weekly path is computed. The author has seen the 21-session replay (KR rule 14.720% vs KODEX 200 14.861%; US rule = SPY) and the full-ledger calibration. Nothing below was chosen from those results; every parameter is the frozen rule's.
rule: Identical to docs/weekly-decision/weekly-passive-first-v1.json 'rule' (module pipeline/weekly_decision.py, unchanged): calibrated 126-session edge only where the bucket is usable, minus stock + ETF round-trip cost, > 0; max 5 names x 15%; max 2 per sector; residual in the regional benchmark ETF; retention credit orders but never admits.

calendar.signalDates: replay_calendar.signal_grid('2013-01-01', through, 'W'): the last UNION (KRX or NYSE) session of each completed ISO week, 715 dates through 2026-09-11. These are the dates the sealed replay-v16 signal ledger was generated on.
calendar.execution: The first COMMON (KRX and NYSE both open) session strictly after the signal date. A signal is never executed on its own date.
calendar.holding: From that execution session to the next week's execution session; one block per week.
calendar.matured: Only blocks whose end session is on or before the frozen input's through date (2026-09-14).

pointInTime.candidates: benchmark_alpha._contexts over the replay-v16 signal ledger: each week's research sleeve uses only that week's signal rows and the previous week's rank-buffer state (price_proxy=True, the convention of every replay-v16 portfolio harness).
pointInTime.calibration: historical_calibration.calibrate on outcomes whose 126-session endDate is on or before that week's signal date; probability block skipped (never read by the rule) with the same full-ledger equality check as the 21-session replay.
pointInTime.noFutureLabels: An outcome maturing after the signal date never enters that week's calibration.

valuation: replay_valuation.ValuationData.window, the same engine and frozen inputs as the 21-session replay; a held name without a valid mark makes the path PARTIAL, never zero-filled.
costs: Identical dated cost table (benchmark_alpha.REALISTIC_COSTS; KR ETF leg without securities transaction tax), charged on every traded weight at every weekly execution.
notIncluded: C1/C2 (legacy CHAMPION) exist only on the sealed 21-session calendar and are not re-selected weekly.
benchmarkDefinition: Same replay-v16 accumulated-index price recipe for stocks and benchmark; NOT reconciled to Phase C's corrected KODEX 200 total return. Headline CAGR cards must not be shown from this replay while that holds.
forbidden: changing any rule parameter after seeing the weekly path
presenting the weekly path as validated or forward evidence
